privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead_summary: Cyber Kovai is committed to safeguarding the confidentiality, privacy, and integrity of all client information, investigation artifacts, vulnerability reports, and digital evidence.
privacy.content:
1. Scope & Commitment

At Cyber Kovai ("we", "our", or "us"), confidentiality and information security form the foundation of our services. This Privacy Policy governs the collection, processing, storage, and protection of personal data and enterprise information acquired through our website, digital forensics engagements, offensive security testing, and client consultations.

2. Information We Collect

Depending on your engagement with Cyber Kovai, we may collect the following categories of information:

  • Inquiry & Contact Information: Name, professional email address, organization name, telephone or Signal/WhatsApp contact number, and service requirements submitted via our portals.
  • Technical & Forensic Artifacts: Under formalized engagement scopes, client-provided disk images, network packet logs, source code repositories, API endpoints, and system metadata necessary to perform digital investigations or penetration tests.
  • Automated Telemetry: Anonymized server logs, browser user-agent, operating system, and IP address collected for website fraud prevention, rate-limiting, and distributed denial-of-service defense.

3. Forensic Chain of Custody & Confidentiality

All evidentiary materials and technical assessment data undergo strict Chain of Custody (CoC) controls:

  • Cryptographic hashing (SHA-256) is generated immediately upon artifact acquisition to verify digital evidence integrity.
  • Forensic work is executed inside air-gapped, encrypted analytical workstations with hardware write-blockers.
  • All team members are bound by comprehensive Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and continuous security vetting.

4. Storage, Encryption & Data Retention

We apply defense-in-depth measures to store and safeguard client data:

  • Data at rest is secured using AES-256 encryption across sovereign, secure server environments.
  • Data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3 cryptographic protocols.
  • Assessment deliverables, vulnerability data, and case artifacts are permanently scrubbed and sanitized following the contractually agreed retention schedule (standard 30–90 days post-deliverable delivery) unless legal preservation holds apply.

5. Non-Disclosure & Third-Party Sharing

Cyber Kovai never sells, leases, or monetizes client data under any circumstances. We do not disclose client information, vulnerability findings, or investigative reports to third parties except when explicitly authorized in writing by the client or strictly mandated by court order or competent law enforcement authority under applicable jurisdiction.

6. Compliance with Global & Regional Standards

Our data handling and privacy practices strictly align with:

  • Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, India
  • General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for international and EU clients
  • ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management
  • NIST Special Publication 800-86 (Integrating Forensic Techniques into Incident Response)

7. Privacy Officer Contact

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, data access requests, or confidential evidence handling, contact our Data Protection Officer:

Cyber Kovai Data Privacy Office
Email: privacy@cyberkovai.com
Official Hotline: +91 63820 19821
Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lead_summary: These Terms and Conditions govern the provision of cybersecurity auditing, penetration testing, digital investigation, and consulting services by Cyber Kovai.
terms.content:
1. Agreement to Terms

By accessing the Cyber Kovai website or commissioning our cybersecurity, vulnerability assessment (VAPT), or digital investigation services, you ("Client" or "User") agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions in conjunction with any formalized Statement of Work (SOW) or Master Services Agreement (MSA).

2. Authorization for Security Audits & Forensics

Prior to initiating any offensive security assessment, red-teaming exercise, or digital forensics examination:

  • The Client explicitly warrants that they possess lawful ownership, administrative control, or formal written authorization from asset owners to perform the requested testing or investigation.
  • Both parties execute an authorized Statement of Work detailing target IP ranges, domains, cloud subscriptions, testing windows, and emergency communication protocols.
  • Cyber Kovai acts strictly as an authorized security researcher and auditor; testing conducted within scope constitutes authorized access under relevant cyber laws including Section 43/66 of the Information Technology Act.

3. Rules of Engagement & Service Limitations

We deploy certified offensive methodologies (OWASP, NIST, PTES) engineered to discover vulnerabilities while minimizing operational disruption:

  • While we take utmost care during active exploitation, the Client acknowledges that testing complex software environments carries inherent operational risks.
  • Denial-of-Service (DoS) and physical intrusion testing are executed only when specifically requested and authorized in the governing SOW.
  • Emergency kill-switch protocols are established for immediate cessation of testing upon request.

4. Confidentiality & Non-Disclosure

Cyber Kovai and the Client mutually agree that all trade secrets, vulnerability reports, exploit code, architecture diagrams, and investigative findings disclosed during an engagement constitute strictly Confidential Information. Neither party will disclose such information to third parties without prior written consent.

5. Deliverables & Intellectual Property

Upon receipt of full payment, all custom vulnerability assessment reports, investigative case dockets, and remediation guidelines authored specifically for the Client become the exclusive property of the Client. Cyber Kovai retains ownership of its proprietary testing tools, automated scanning scripts, and general security knowledge base.

6. Limitation of Liability

Cyber Kovai delivers industry-leading security evaluations; however, the absence of discovered vulnerabilities during an audit does not constitute a guarantee that the evaluated systems are completely impenetrable against novel zero-day threats. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Cyber Kovai's aggregate liability arising out of any engagement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Client for the specific service under dispute.

7. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any legal dispute, claim, or proceeding arising under these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

disclosure.title: Security & Vulnerability Disclosure
disclosure.lead_summary: Cyber Kovai welcomes responsible disclosure from security researchers and ethical hackers to safeguard our digital perimeter and protect our community.
disclosure.content:
1. Our Commitment & Safe Harbor

Security is our core mission. Cyber Kovai appreciates the invaluable contributions of the independent security research community. If you believe you have identified a security vulnerability affecting Cyber Kovai's public digital properties or services, we encourage you to report it responsibly.

Safe Harbor Commitment: If you conduct your research in good faith, strictly adhere to this policy, and avoid data destruction or unauthorized access to third-party data, Cyber Kovai commits to:

  • Not initiating legal action or law enforcement referrals against you.
  • Working cooperatively to understand, validate, and remediate the issue promptly.
  • Publicly acknowledging your contribution in our Security Hall of Fame (with your permission).

2. Scope of Testing

The following domains and assets are within scope for responsible disclosure:

  • *.cyberkovai.com web applications and public APIs
  • Official Cyber Kovai mobile application endpoints

Out of Scope: Third-party client environments, client infrastructure hosted by Cyber Kovai partners, physical office security, social engineering (phishing, vishing) directed at employees, and automated volumetric Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks.

3. Rules of Engagement

When conducting security research, please ensure that you:

  • Make a good-faith effort to avoid privacy violations, degradation of user experience, and destruction or manipulation of production data.
  • Only interact with accounts or test data that you own or have explicit permission to audit.
  • Immediately halt testing and notify us if you encounter sensitive personal or enterprise data; do not view, copy, or distribute it.
  • Provide us with a reasonable window (standard 90 days) to investigate and patch the vulnerability prior to public disclosure.

4. How to Submit a Vulnerability Report

Please submit detailed reports to our dedicated Security Operations Center team at:

Security Ingestion: security@cyberkovai.com
Encrypted PGP Key: Available upon request or via standard key servers.

Include the following details in your report to expedite triage:

  • Detailed description of the vulnerability, including technical impact and CVSS score estimate.
  • Step-by-step reproduction instructions, HTTP request/response logs, and Proof-of-Concept (PoC) code.
  • Target URL, affected endpoint, and specific parameter.

5. Remediation Response SLAs

  • Acknowledgment: Within 24–48 hours of initial submission.
  • Triage & Validation: Within 5 business days.
  • Remediation Timeline: Critical (14 days), High (30 days), Medium/Low (60–90 days).
